skill.summary: Your personal AI assistant platform — multi-agent orchestration, task management, and autonomous workflow execution for one-person companies.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of One Person Company skill.

- Provides multi-agent orchestration for solo founders and one-person teams
- Enables autonomous task management and workflow execution
- Supports persistent memory across sessions
- Requires ONEPERSON_API_KEY environment variable for API access
- Documentation and setup instructions available at 1person.pro and docs.1person.pro
